papers.title: Biased 5-HT1A agonist NLX-101 improves executive function under NMDA receptor hypofunction and preferentially enhances cortical ERK2 phosphorylation.
papers.reason: The paper appears to report animal neuropharmacological findings on executive function under NMDA receptor hypofunction with cortical signaling measures, relevant to mechanisms of cognitive control.

papers.title: Apigenin modulates serotonergic and noradrenergic transmission in postnatally induced two-hit neurodevelopmental psychosis in rodents
papers.reason: The study links working-memory behavior in a rodent psychosis model to serotonergic and noradrenergic changes in prefrontal, hippocampal, and amygdala regions, though its main focus is pharmacological treatment.

papers.title: Diagnostic Challenges in Seronegative Section Autoimmune Limbic Encephalitis Presenting as Faciobrachial Dystonic Seizures: A Case Report
papers.reason: This is a clinical diagnostic case report about autoimmune limbic encephalitis and seizure presentation, with cognitive impairment only mentioned generally and no substantive executive-function modelling or assessment component.

papers.title: Noradrenergic gain failure and cognitive-state instability in aging and Alzheimer's disease
papers.reason: The review develops a control-layer model of LC–norepinephrine gain dysfunction linking arousal dynamics to attention, memory access, reaction-time variability, and cognitive instability in aging and Alzheimer's disease.
